title: TSMC Board of Directors Meeting Resolutions, August 11, 2026 (SEC-filed Form 6-K)
publisher: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: The board approved about USD 29.44 billion for advanced technology, advanced packaging, specialty capacity, fab construction and facility systems, plus a JPY282 billion Sony joint-venture investment.
summary: The SEC-filed resolutions confirm Q2 financials, a NT$7 quarterly dividend, a major new capacity appropriation and a material image-sensor joint-venture commitment, reinforcing runway while increasing capital-allocation execution risk.
